tasks.title: Crear Value Object SkillLevel con enum y validacion
tasks.description: Crear SkillLevel value object con propiedad Level (enum SkillLevelType: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert, Professional) y AssessedAt (DateTime). Factory method Create(level). Metodo DisplayName para localizacion. Implementar equality members.

tasks.title: Agregar metodo UpdateSkillLevel a Profile
tasks.description: Agregar a la entidad Profile el metodo UpdateSkillLevel(SkillLevel) que actualiza SkillLevel y AssessedAt. Eleva evento SkillLevelChanged.

tasks.title: Crear evento SkillLevelChanged
tasks.description: Crear SkillLevelChangedEvent con UserId, ProfileId, PreviousLevel, NewLevel, AssessedAt.

tasks.title: Crear comando UpdateSkillLevelCommand y handler
tasks.description: Crear UpdateSkillLevelCommand con SkillLevel. Validador: nivel debe ser valor valido del enum. Handler: obtener perfil del usuario autenticado, llamar UpdateSkillLevel, guardar, publicar SkillLevelChanged, retornar SkillLevelResponse.

tasks.title: Crear DTO SkillLevelResponse
tasks.description: Crear SkillLevelResponse con SkillLevel, AssessedAt, Message.

tasks.title: Agregar migracion SkillLevel en Profiles
tasks.description: Si aun no existe, agregar columnas skill_level y assessed_at a profiles.

tasks.title: Crear endpoint PUT /api/identity/profile/skill-level
tasks.description: Crear endpoint protegido. Recibe SkillLevel en body, ejecuta UpdateSkillLevelCommand. Retorna SkillLevelResponse.
